tested_scope.procedure: Create generation A with an immutable role-semantic witness, record commit/tree/blob identities and a SHA-256 digest copied to a separately stored directory, delete the entire same-domain repository, initialize generation B at the same path, then test whether generation-A Git objects resolve and whether the separately stored digest survives.
tested_scope.limits: This is a bounded logical/local-Git model of complete same-authority-domain replacement. It is not evidence about undocumented GitHub backend retention, provider backups, or any external service availability.

result.finding: Within the tested model, once the complete Git authority domain is replaced and no copy of generation-A state is retained inside generation B, same-domain commit/tree/blob identities cannot recover the old semantic witness. A witness stored outside the replaced domain survives. Therefore same-domain-only fail-closed machinery can prevent false recovery but cannot by itself restore liveness after total domain replacement; recovery with continuity requires some durability/authority not destroyed by the same reset, or acceptance of fail-closed loss of liveness.
result.reason_current_O_not_read: The single bounded slice targeted the unresolved durability-domain boundary and did not spend an additional semantic leaf on a fresh O snapshot. No protected O authority was read for mutation or modified.
result.unresolved_child: Determine from a future pinned read-only O snapshot whether any authorized separately administered durable witness actually exists for O continuity. If none exists, retain the full-domain-reset liveness boundary as unresolved rather than inferring durability from same-domain Git references.

exact_next_action: On the next invocation, after pinning the then-current authorized O read-only snapshot under the current control tuple, execute exactly one bounded comparison slice to test whether O has any separately administered, non-O-repository durable continuity witness that is within Phase-1 scope. If no such witness is evidenced, record the full-domain-reset liveness boundary as unresolved/persistent without proposing or performing O mutation.
